protocol.prediction: Paid changes of cyclic phase may expose an interior join shorter than the exact-state control.
protocol.reverse: Reverse conjugation direction against the same canonical word and same entry/donor pair.
protocol.control: Shortest witnessed exact-state prefix/suffix join on the same graph.
arms: best of their four per-relator compositions
protocol.equal_scope: All arms visit the same eligible entry/donor pairs; shared 180s/600000-record/1024-MiB cap. Record partial coverage as blocked, not a completed negative.
protocol.scope: Fixed normalizer recipes only, not a shortest-conjugator theorem. All inversions, conjugations, prefix and suffix moves paid and replayed. No permutations, generator substitutions or neighborhood expansion.
